description: Automates the Oracle feat Foretell Harm (Player Core 2, Feat 1, cursebound / divine / oracle). Free action, once per round, after casting a damaging non-cantrip spell: the target takes damage equal to twice the spell's rank, of a type matching the spell, at the start of its next turn, then is immune for 24 hours. The PF2e system ships this feat with no rule elements, so this module tracks the delayed damage and the immunity for you. No arming step — the GM's client installs the turn hook automatically on ready.
title: Foretell Harm — Oracle Automation
